name: Summit AZ - Pipe Lining City Pages
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-10-03

# Summary
Two pieces of work on the pipe lining (signature service) city pages: a full rewrite of /pipe-lining-mesa/ (Sep 26) and a claims audit plus fix draft across all 10 /pipe-lining-<city>/ pages (Oct 3). Files: `Summit-AZ-Pipe-Lining-Mesa-Draft-2026-09-26.md`, `Summit-AZ-Pipe-Lining-Audit-Fix-Draft-2026-10-03.md` and the machine change list `Summit-AZ-Pipe-Lining-Fix-Ops-2026-10-03.json` (141 field edits plus 6 Rank Math fields, each with the exact current value).

# Mesa rewrite (page 10205, Sep 26)
- Was 83% identical to Gilbert at position 9 to 12. Rebuilt on City of Mesa sewer facts (lateral ownership, cleanout access and caps).
- Keywords: pipe lining (3,600 / KD 6) kept, sewer pipe lining (2,400 / 8) added. "epoxy pipe lining" (720 / 15) not targeted because epoxy is unconfirmed. Trenchless terms dropped so the Mesa blog keeps them.
- Applied live Sep 26 (handoff). Mesa kept its "Epoxy Pipe Lining" card heading on Kim's call.

# Audit findings (Oct 3)
- Six template pages (Apache Junction, Chandler, Fountain Hills, Gilbert, Queen Creek, San Tan Valley): 6 to 8 epoxy claims each, CIPP or heat/UV wording, "50+ years" lifespan, cost and speed claims, unapproved neighborhood lists, 3 em dashes, 49 to 63% copy shared with siblings.
- Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe: fewer epoxy mentions and a speed box; Scottsdale and Tempe had two FAQ answers swapped. Phoenix had "epoxy pipe lining Phoenix" as a focus keyword.
- Every page: a "Fast Response" box and an "all EAST VALLEY cities" line that omits Apache Junction and Fountain Hills.

# Proposed fixes
- Remove epoxy everywhere ("Epoxy Pipe Lining" cards become "Lining Options"), replace CIPP and heat/UV with the approved Mesa wording (a resin-coated liner cured in place), replace "50+ years" with a no-number answer, drop cost and speed claims.

# Decisions and status
- Applied Oct 3: categories 4 (unsourced local-home claims) and 5 (unapproved neighborhoods) on the 6 template pages (22 field edits plus 5 metas), plus the swapped FAQ fix on Scottsdale and Tempe.
- Still draft: epoxy, CIPP, lifespan, cost and speed claims. The ops JSON is out of date for fields already changed and must be regenerated before applying the rest.
- Related claim cleanup on /pipe-lining-apache-junction/ and /pipe-lining-chandler/ is in [Summit AZ - Service Page Rewrites and Claim Cleanup](lib:brain-summit-az-service-page-rewrites-and-claim-cleanup).
